notes: Found by a concept screen for years and periods (branch 14 of a concept map around the Texas pole bonsai1/L10/N8330+): 3/6 Revolutionary War passages, all year-only pairs (1777, 1781, 1776; controls 1807, 1831, 1796 < 0.1).
